bone_mapping.method: FK: world-space rotation delta of the KayKit bone vs the shared T-pose (KayKit rest, Hodling rest are both T-pose, +X = character left), composed on the Hodling rest rotation of the ctl_ bone and converted to pose-bone basis. Legs: end-effector retarget (hip-joint centre + ankles scaled by S_leg and given to ctl_cog / ctl_*_Foot_IK, heel/ball roll from foot pitch); knees solved by the rig's own IK. Arms stay FK (ik_arm_L/R keyed 0, ik_leg_L/R keyed 1).
bone_mapping.S_leg_definition: hip-joint-to-ankle height of the Hodling rest (0.130 m) / the same on the KayKit T-pose

translation.ctl_cog: mean(upperleg.l, upperleg.r) position, scaled by S_leg, delta from T-pose
translation.ctl_L_Foot_IK / ctl_R_Foot_IK: foot.l / foot.r ankle position, scaled by S_leg, delta from T-pose; yaw+pitch from the source foot orientation

secondary_not_from_source.ctl_sack: damped lag (3 Hz, zeta 0.45) of chest rotation, 70 % blend
secondary_not_from_source.ctl_helmet: damped lag (4 Hz, 0.40) of head rotation, 35 %
secondary_not_from_source.ctl_L_ear / ctl_R_ear: same lag of the head, x1.5
secondary_not_from_source.ctl_loincloth_front: hip-flexion rule (-30 deg at 70 deg) raised per frame to the MEASURED smallest world-X angle that leaves no new flap<->thigh intersection (+5 deg), smoothed

bone_mapping.no_finger_bones: the Hodling has no finger bones; hands cannot close (attack = open-hand strike)

gui_session: rig/anim/qa/gui/gui_play_test.json (real Blender window, ordinary Play operator driven by a timer; not a human click)
